关键词: Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series F
主要内容: Royal Bank of Canada issued $400,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 1.170% Senior Notes, due March 30, 2017. The issuance is part of the Bank’s shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-189888). The report includes legal opinions from Sullivan & Cromwell LLP and Norton Rose Fulbright Canada LLP regarding the validity of the Notes and U.S. federal income taxation. The report was filed on March 20, 2014, and is incorporated by reference into the Bank’s registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-189888).
